component.name: Align
component.summary: Sync your recordings. Keep your edit.

description.p: Synchronize camera footage and separately recorded audio using waveforms, timecode, and recording metadata. Review your timeline and export it to Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or an AAF-compatible editor.
Align works locally. Original recordings stay untouched. The desktop app, command-line tools, AAF module, FFmpeg, and ffprobe are included.
